_comment: Drive file IDs from the Prayag catalog (public/file_ids.json origin). Registers are the 'State Head Sale' files (line-item detail). The register tab is auto-detected (the tab whose header row contains CODE + QTY + AMOUNT), so no fixed A1 range is needed.

sale_register.desc: Line-item sales ledger: one row per invoice line with CODE, QTY, AMOUNT, GROUP, STATION, STATE, STATE HEAD, DATE.

rate_master.desc: IMPORTRANGE source for item rates/groups. Dirty: duplicate rows per code, zeros, Sale Price==MRP. Cost source only, needs dedup (see normalize).

cost_master.desc: RECOMMENDED — create this: one row per Item Code -> Finished-Good Cost, fed from BOM/GP sheets. The clean cost source for margins. Leave id empty until created; margins will be skipped and flagged (low cost coverage) until then.
